desc: Howard, in a gray-and-red plaid shirt, is talking with someone on the phone while Raj is looking at him very seriously.
Howard, in a gray-and-red plaid shirt, moves his mouth anxiously, smiling, while sitting at the canteen.
Sheldon, in an orange shirt, gets up and run from the lunch table at the cafeteria.
Sheldon, in an orange shirt, is taking his clothes out of his dresser to pack them when Leonard walks in.
Sheldon holds up two beanies by his head.
Leonard, in yellow hoodie and purple jacket, carries over a tray of fondue items and sets it on the coffee table.
Penny picks up a chocolate bar from the tray and sets it back down.
Leonard, in yellow hoodie and purple jacket, starts slicing the cheese with a knife.
Penny is holding Leonard's arm, while he holds a small knife in his hand, while sitting on the couch.
Penny gets really excited, and she and Leonard, in a yellow hoodie and purple jacket, hug each other.
Leonard, in a yellow hoodie and purple jacket, does strange frustrated movements with his body, then throws himself onto the sofa.
Penny, in a red blouse, and Leonard both look down while sitting on the couch and Penny put her hand on his shoulder.
Sheldon, in an orange shirt,  grabs his throat and moves his mouth in weird positions.
Sheldon, in a grey jacket, turns his head to Leonard, smiling, in the car.
Leonard, in a navy hoodie and green jacket, says something, and Sheldon quickly gives him a dirty look, in the car.
Sheldon walks up to the cafeteria table, puts down a tray with only utensils and walks away.
Leonard wakes up with a smile to find Sheldon standing by his bed, playing a wooden flute.
Sheldon picks up a breakfast tray and sets it in front of Leonard.
Sheldon picks up a beret and puts it on Leonard's pancakes to keep them warm.
Sheldon, standing by Leonard's bed, hands him a scone with kitchen tongs.
Leonard takes the coffee mug from the bed tray and drinks it.
Sheldon removes the breakfast tray from Leonard's bed and walks out of the room.
Sheldon places a laptop on a table next to Penny, folding clothes in the laundry room.
Sheldon walks up and flips the light switch to turn off the lights in the laundry room.
Sheldon uses a remote control and turns on the projector's light in the laundry room.
Penny walks towards the wall with a light switch and turns on the lights in the laundry room.
Penny is folding clothes when Sheldon closes his laptop as they are in the laundry room.
Sheldon puts away the laptop in his hand and runs back into the laundry room to give Penny a hug.
Happy Sheldon, in a purple shirt, puts food from a frying pan down onto a plate.
Howard makes some uncomfortable faces and Leonard, in a red hoodie and grey jacket, scratches his head.
Penny suddenly sneezes and quickly grabs a tissue while lying in the bed with Leonard.
Leonard is outside the bathroom door and massages his belly with a pained face.
Sheldon with a red nose, walks out of the room with a tissue in his hand.
A shot of a living room glass table covered in medications, with sick Sheldon sitting on the couch next to it under a blanket, blowing his nose.
Penny sits beside Sheldon on the couch with a bowl in her hand and covers herself under the blanket.
Leonard opens a hotel room with Raj behind him, both in thick puffer jackets.
Upset Leonard, in a thick puffer jacket, takes champagne from the ice bucket at the hotel room.
